data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at 1 January 2017 were GBP 110.778m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows favourable development on the older underwriting years (2014 and 2015) totalling approximately GBP 25.53m (a release), driven by positive claims development / IBNR recalibration. Overall this represents a c.23.1% reduction versus opening gross reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims development tables are shown on an underwriting year basis below.

The adverse development cover policy is designed to provide capital relief for these years of account and reduce volatility resulting from exposure to insurance risk, where the Syndicate has ceded GBP 0.2m of premiums in respect of this policy.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was not stated as a single gross movement figure. The prior year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative ultimate estimates) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <= 2015. The syndicate is an SPA with cessions and Reinsurance-to-Close activity which can distort comparisons; triangle-based PYD was used as the best available gross measure. Exact textual description of a gross prior-year movement was not explicitly stated in a single sentence.
